name: openai
label: OpenAI
description: Chat, images, audio and embeddings from OpenAI models.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Go to https://platform.openai.com/api-keys, click Create new secret key and copy it. Add credit to your OpenAI account first, or every request fails with a 429 quota error.

ask_chatgpt.label: Ask ChatGPT
ask_chatgpt.description: Send a question or instruction to an OpenAI model and get a reply.

model.label: Model
model.description: The OpenAI model that writes the reply.

prompt.label: Question
prompt.description: What you want the model to answer or do.

maxTokens.label: Maximum Tokens
maxTokens.description: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: From 0 to 2. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.

topP.label: Top P
topP.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency Penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher values make the model repeat itself less.

presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty
presencePenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher values push the model toward new topics.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Messages sent before the question, such as a system instruction.

vision_prompt.label: Vision Prompt
vision_prompt.description: Ask a question about an image and get a text reply.

prompt.label: Question
prompt.description: What you want to know about the image.

maxTokens.label: Maximum Tokens
maxTokens.description: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.

detail.label: Detail
detail.description: Low is faster and cheaper. High reads small details better.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: From 0 to 2. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.

topP.label: Top P
topP.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency Penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher values make the model repeat itself less.

presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty
presencePenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Higher values push the model toward new topics.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Messages sent before the question, such as a system instruction.

extract-structured-data.label: Extract Structured Data
extract-structured-data.description: Pull the fields you define out of a block of text.

model.label: Model
model.description: The OpenAI model that reads the text.

text.label: Text
text.description: The text to pull the fields from.

params.label: Fields
params.description: One row per value you want back: [{"propName": "invoice_total", "propDescription": "Total due", "propDataType": "string, number or boolean", "propIsRequired": false}].

classify_text.label: Moderate Text
classify_text.description: Check text against OpenAI's rules on hate, violence and similar harm.

model.label: Model
model.description: Moderation model. The default suits most uses.

classify_text.afterResponse:
const result = response.results[0];
return { flagged: result?.flagged ?? false, categories: result?.categories ?? {}, category_scores: result?.category_scores ?? {}, model: response.model, id: response.id };

analyze_sentiment.label: Analyze Text Sentiment
analyze_sentiment.description: Label text as positive, negative or neutral.

model.label: Model
model.description: The model that judges the sentiment.

text.label: Text
text.description: A message, review or any other text.

messages.content: You are a sentiment classifier. Respond ONLY with a JSON object of the form {"sentiment": "positive" | "negative" | "neutral", "confidence": number between 0 and 1, "explanation": string}.

create_embedding.label: Create Embedding
create_embedding.description: Turn text into a vector for semantic search or clustering.

model.label: Model
model.description: Embedding model. The default suits most uses.

input.label: Text
input.description: The text to turn into a vector.

dimensions.label: Vector Dimensions
dimensions.description: Vector length. Works only with text-embedding-3 models.

user.label: User ID
user.description: Your own ID for the end user. Helps OpenAI spot abuse.

create_embedding.afterResponse: return { model: response.model, embedding: response.data[0]?.embedding ?? [], data: response.data, usage: response.usage };

search_embeddings.label: Search Embeddings
search_embeddings.description: Rank a list of texts by how closely they match a query.

model.label: Model
model.description: Embedding model used for the query and the documents.

query.label: Query
query.description: The text to match the documents against.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: The texts to rank, as a JSON list such as ["first text", "second text"].

topK.label: Max Results
topK.description: Empty: every document, best match first.

list_files.label: List Files
list_files.description: List the files in your OpenAI account.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: Only include files with this purpose.

limit.label: Max Results
limit.description: Up to this many files, from 1 to 10,000.

find_file.label: Find File
find_file.description: Look up files in your OpenAI account by exact name.

fileName.label: File Name
fileName.description: Exact file name, including the extension. Case does not matter.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: Only include files with this purpose.

delete_file.label: Delete File
delete_file.description: Delete a file you uploaded to OpenAI.

fileId.label: File ID
fileId.description: Starts with file-. Upload, List and Find File return it.

list_models.label: List Models
list_models.description: List the models your OpenAI account can use.

contains.label: Name Contains
contains.description: Only return models whose name includes this text.
